lists.name: Juno Awards: Album of the Year

podcast.body: This 2000 album was directly influenced by the band reading the technology-focused books of inventor and thinker Ray Kurzweil. The band's fascination with Kurzweil's ideas shaped the album's themes and many of their songs, reflecting his early involvement in the nexus of music and artificial intelligence. "Their 2000 albums, spiritual machines, came about after the band read through so of Kurzweil's books on technology."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History and Future of AI in Music
